svg.title: Layout of the metadata block
svg.desc: The metadata block of the 2.0 coder stream to scale against the block of 1.0: part A with one record per page in page order, part B with one record per page sorted by revision id, split into B1 and B2; record forms of part A and part B with real records of the stream as byte boxes.
svg.text: 3,743,100 B at the head of the coder stream (1.0: 5,164,151 B), behind a stream header of 39 B, two records per page (243,425 pages)
243,425 records in the order of the pages
Part B: sorted by revision id as in 1.0. The names moved to the contributor article.

text.tspan: page id as a difference to the page before, then the revision id

svg.text: record 0, the first page of the stream
record 3; a revision id below 17,000,000 (87,813 records)
is the residual against an interpolation over the nearest
page ids seen before; here exact: revision id 15,898,943

text.tspan: timestamp in six bytes of base 100, then a mark in place of the name

svg.text: record 7; the next line of the contributor article holds the name

text.tspan: timestamp as the difference in seconds to the record before, decimal

svg.text: part B: 04, then two bytes per octet
Base 100. One byte per two decimal digits: 0x80 + value.
Marks. 19,506 records carry 05 (a name that appears for the first time, its user id behind it), 185,891 carry 03 (a repeated name).
Each mark stands for the next line of the contributor article in the text start.
In place. 35,615 records keep an address, 2,413 keep their name in part B.
Forecast. In front of every record of part B a forecast of its timestamp is fed to the models; it is not coded. From
record 87,813 on it follows the slope of the last records.
